context: This evaluates the ability to use superagent's progress event to monitor download progress for large file transfers.

checklist.name: Use on() for events
checklist.description: Uses the on() method to listen for the 'progress' event

checklist.name: Event name
checklist.description: Correctly specifies 'progress' as the event name

checklist.name: Callback invocation
checklist.description: Calls the progressCallback with the event data from the progress event

checklist.name: Response handling
checklist.description: Returns the response body after download completes
